profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
I am a Full Stack Software Developer at Epic in Verona, WI. In 2025 I graduated Summa Cum Laude from Tufts University with my Bachelor of Science Degree in Computer Science. During my time at Tufts I was an active member and 2-year captain of the NCAA Division III Baseball Program and received Dean's List Honors in 6 semesters. I was a member of the team's Team Impact Leadership Committee, a Green Dot Team Representative, and a part of the program's ongoing relationship with Big Brothers Big Sisters of Eastern Mass.

My technical skills include AI, machine learning, game design, web programming, knowledge about data structures, programming languages, machine structure, and assembly language. I am experienced in many coding languages and digital tools such as MUMPS (M), C, C++, C#, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Python, XML, JSON, Git, SQL, Blender, Photoshop, Unity, and Excel.
